remarks: Morning coffee in the garden. Dinner beneath the pergola. A private movie screening above the primary suite. At 626 14th Street, every part of the home offers a reason to stay awhile. Set behind a gated entrance and lush hedges in Santa Monica's coveted North of Montana neighborhood, this six-bedroom, four-bath residence combines approximately 4,400 square feet of inviting interiors with beautifully arranged outdoor spaces on a roughly 7,500-square-foot lot. Towering palms, stone accents, and rich wood detailing establish a warm welcome.
